name: Zone of Truth
description:
You establish an area where lies become visible. The area has a radius of short range and must include you when you create it. Roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature in the area when you cast the spell, or that enters it, must roll Spirit against the Difficulty. On a pass, the creature is unaffected (and you know it). On a failure, it is affected.

When an affected creature speaks a deliberate lie within the area, a harmless visual effect of your choice—such as dark smoke or sparks—emerges from its mouth as it speaks.

The area remains fixed even if you move or leave it. A creature that leaves the area is no longer affected and must roll again if it re-enters.

Describe how you make lies visible.
